g.text: Each partition worker holds a fixed-size sketch and heap; the merge only ever sums counter arrays, never re-scans the log
If the Merge Coordinator summed sketches before every partition finished,
the merge would run against an incomplete sketch -- a silently wrong top-K.
Merging waits on partition_checkpoints(run_id, status='done') for every partition --
cell-by-cell sketch addition is cheap and order-independent once that barrier clears.
